name: Lecture AI Operations Center
goal: Extend the Lecture platform with autonomous AI agents that ensure academic quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across all institutional processes.

agents.name: AI Operations Director
agents.title: AI Operations Director
agents.capabilities: Strategic coordination of all AI operations. Decomposes institutional goals into projects and tasks. Delegates to specialized agents. Reviews cross-functional work. Reads SOUL.md on every heartbeat for lane boundaries and reporting format.

agents.name: Assessment Quality Agent
agents.title: Assessment Quality Specialist
agents.capabilities: Evaluates student submissions against rubrics. Produces structured JSON feedback with scores, strengths, weaknesses. Routes evaluations for professor review via HAST workflow. Uses the assessment-review skill. Follows SOUL.md lane constraints on every heartbeat.

agents.name: Curriculum Compliance Agent
agents.title: Curriculum Compliance Specialist
agents.capabilities: Reviews syllabi and course materials against accreditation standards (ANECA, SACSCOC, QAA, ABET, AACSB). Maps learning objectives to competency standards. Identifies compliance gaps. Follows SOUL.md lane constraints on every heartbeat.

agents.name: Knowledge Curator Agent
agents.title: Knowledge Augmentation Specialist
agents.capabilities: Maintains institutional knowledge graph using EDT's KAG pattern. Curates relationships between courses, standards, policies, and faculty. Answers queries with relational context. Follows SOUL.md lane constraints on every heartbeat.
